subject.title: docs: document accepted low-severity security trade-offs

question: Should Crabbox formally accept all three documented security trade-offs as Low/P3 residual risks, or should any linked issue remain a remediation requirement?
rationale: Source inspection can verify the behavior and the accuracy of the warnings, but it cannot determine whether credential replay, launch-data private-key exposure, and authenticated identity disclosure are acceptable permanent product boundaries.

options.title: Approve each acceptance explicitly
options.body: Record acceptance on all three linked issues and merge the documentation if the stated severity, prerequisites, and mitigations match the intended security policy.

options.title: Narrow the accepted set
options.body: Remove acceptance language for any disputed risk and merge only the warnings that have an explicit security decision.

options.title: Require remediation first
options.body: Keep the linked issues open as required security work and replace “accepted” wording with neutral current-risk documentation until fixes land.

recommendation.title: Approve each acceptance explicitly
recommendation.body: Record acceptance on all three linked issues and merge the documentation if the stated severity, prerequisites, and mitigations match the intended security policy.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available project-steward and proposal-author signal for deciding whether these behaviors are intentional permanent security boundaries.
